# 74121 - Monostable multivibrator

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74121.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74121.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | Q = PULSE | Q goes high for tw(out) after a trigger, then low. Trigger = a rising edge of T where T = B AND NOT(A1 AND A2): a falling edge on A1 or A2 while B is high and the other A is high, or a rising edge on B while A1 or A2 is low. |
| 1 | /Q = NOT PULSE | Complement of Q. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 1

Changes on: rising edge of T = B AND (A1' OR A2')

- Steady state: Q low, Q' high (function table rows with no trigger transition)
- Trigger: Q goes high and Q' low for tw(out); once fired the outputs do not depend on further input transitions (not retriggerable)
- Pulse width tw(out) = Cext * RT * ln 2, about 0.7 * Cext * RT (RT = Rext or Rint), within the jitter-free range of Cext 10 pF to 10 uF and RT 2 kOhm to 40 kOhm (SN74121)
- With no external timing parts (Rint to VCC, Cext and Rext/Cext open) the pulse is typically 30 or 35 ns
- Input pulses may be of any duration relative to the output pulse

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| notes | Schmitt input B: VT+ typ 1.55 V, max 2 V; VT- min 0.8 V, typ 1.35 V. Rext 1.4 to 40 kOhm (74), Cext 0 to 1000 uF. Duty cycle max 67% at RT 2 kOhm, 90% at RT = max Rext. Input pulse width min 50 ns. Rate of rise or fall: B min 1 V/s, A1/A2 min 1 V/us. B input IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at Cext 80 pF, Rint to VCC; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 or A2 | Q | PLH | 45 | 70 |
| B | Q | PLH | 35 | 55 |
| A1 or A2 | /Q | PHL | 50 | 80 |
| B | /Q | PHL | 40 | 65 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Min ns |
|---|---|---|
| pulse width | A1, A2, B (input pulse) | 50 |
| output pulse width | Q | 70 |
| output pulse width | Q |  |
| output pulse width | Q | 600 |
| output pulse width | Q | 6000000 |

## Not known

- The resistance of the internal timing resistor Rint is not stated on the pages read.

## Notes

Formula for the pulse width from the datasheet description: tw(out) = Cext RT ln2 = 0.7 Cext RT.
